description.narrative: The project development objective for the Nuton Jibon Livelihood Improvement Project for Bangladesh is to improve livelihoods of the poor and extreme poor in the project areas. This project is comprised of three components and their subcomponents. (1) Community institutions and livelihood development component will: (i) mobilize the poor and extreme poor in selected rural communities by building and strengthening beneficiary community institutions; (ii) provide funding for small infrastructure and livelihood support for project beneficiaries; and (iii) provide nutrition awareness and agricultural production knowledge. (2) Business development and institutional strengthening component will increase livelihood opportunities of poor and extreme poor by facilitating their organization into producer groups, cooperatives and societies and by improving their market and business orientation and forward and backward linkages in the market systems. (3) The project management, monitoring and learning component will continue supporting third party monitoring and impact evaluation activities as well as build and expand on communication and presentation aspects.
The proposed Project Development Objective is to improve livelihoods of the poor and extreme poor in the project areas.

title.narrative: 2.1 Project beneficiaries and outrech - Direct Project beneficiaries

comment.narrative: <p>Target substantially achieved, with 92.5%. The indicator measures direct beneficiary households, defined as those households who are members of Gram Parishads. NJLIP reached 398,170 extreme poor and poor households in NJLIP villages and 526,928 extreme poor and poor households in SIPP-II villages. In total 925,098 extreme poor and poor households were reached. The indicator target is achieved by 92.5 percent. </p>

<p>Source: MIS</p>
